d:
Donald Trump has backed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amid an ongoing investigation linked to China. The probe is looking into concerns involving Huang, Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang and Nvidia’s chip dealings. Nvidia’s board has formed an independent committee to examine the matter with outside legal advisers. The company says there is currently no indication that US national security or Nvidia’s secrets were compromised.
The investigation could have wider implications for Nvidia and the US-China race over advanced AI chips.
